source.snippet: Business AWS team needs AdministratorAccess for core operations but PrismaCloud flags permanent IAM groups with that policy as medium-severity alerts. Team seeks a compliant architecture that satisfies the scanner without losing needed access. Captured 2026-10-14.

problem_statement: DevOps and cloud security teams in businesses using cloud security posture tools like PrismaCloud receive persistent medium/high alerts for necessary IAM admin access, but lack guided workflows to implement just-in-time or break-glass access patterns that satisfy scanners without disrupting operations.
target_segment: DevOps engineers and cloud security teams at SMB-to-enterprise companies running AWS with compliance tooling (PrismaCloud, Wiz, etc.)
notes: Buyer signal: business environment explicitly stated; company pays for both AWS and PrismaCloud (neither is cheap). Pain is recurring compliance friction. Opportunity: a lightweight just-in-time IAM elevation service or Terraform module pattern that auto-resolves CSPM alerts while maintaining operational access.
